# Test cases of the siphash package, kept as data.
#
# One case per line: OPERATION|KEY|MESSAGE|EXPECTED. OPERATION is the command line of
# tests/driver.bmb, KEY (16 bytes) and MESSAGE are hex, EXPECTED is the hex of the
# little-endian bytes of the result. Lines that start with # are comments.
#
# From the original crate, src/tests.rs and src/tests128.rs: the vectors of the SipHash
# reference implementation (message 00 01 .. of length t, key 00 .. 0f, given to the
# origin as the words k0 = 0x0706050403020100, k1 = 0x0f0e0d0c0b0a0908), each checked
# one-shot and written one byte at a time, as the origin's tests do.

# test_siphash_2_4
